title: Keep the unpaid-invoices panel answering after its first refresh

blocks.text: The billing page has an "unpaid" panel. It is created when an accountant opens the page, and every refresh asks it for the number of unpaid invoices, their total and their ids. The ledger it is given is the billing service's live list, and new invoices are appended to it while the page is open.

`UnpaidInvoices` already answers all three questions from one place. Finish the `TODO` in `src/main/java/practice/UnpaidInvoices.java`: `unpaidOf(ledger)`, where those answers get the unpaid invoices from.

When you're done, a panel answers every question on every refresh for as long as it is open, and an invoice appended to the ledger after the panel was created shows up on the next refresh. About two lines.

cases.says: a new panel counts the unpaid invoices of the ledger
a new panel adds up the amount of the unpaid invoices
a new panel lists the unpaid invoice ids in ledger order
one panel answers count, total and ids again and again, not only the first question
an unpaid invoice appended to the ledger after the panel was created appears in its next answer

origin.section: A Stream Can Be Consumed Once, So Keep a Supplier, Not the Stream

concepts: Code that needs the same pipeline more than once keeps a Supplier<Stream<T>> or a method that builds a new stream on every use, not a stored Stream.
